title: Prioritize provider-neutral Model Infrastructure Manager across text, image, voice and ML
summary: Operator explicitly superseded the ORCH-0024 maintenance/pause recommendation with a high-priority implementation request: build a provider-neutral Model Infrastructure Manager / Compute Broker. It must continuously research and benchmark new model releases, intelligently route benign work across subscription/API models and legitimate low-refusal/open/abliterated workloads across self-hosted/cloud models, manage RunPod-first but multi-provider compute and local credentials, compare API/serverless/GPU economics, quote and budget paid jobs before launch, and support image generation/editing, multimodal inference, LoRA/fine-tuning/general ML, and first-class voice/audio workloads (ASR, TTS, speech-to-speech, conversion, diarization, enhancement, alignment, audio generation and supported adaptation/training). The detailed roadmap is projects/personal-agent-os/roadmap/model-infrastructure-manager.md (IMP-0015). Safety-relevant context must not be intentionally concealed; consequential actions, spending and secret access remain deterministic policy gates.
prior_art: Required before implementation: model gateways/routers, cloud GPU brokers, model registries/eval systems, training job managers.
